title: Elliptic Boundary Value Problems and Partial Group Actions
summary: We consider a smooth compact manifold with boundary, $M$, embedded in a smooth manifold of the same dimension on which an amenable group $Γ$ acts by isometries. We do not assume $M$ to be invariant under $Γ$. This results in a {\em partial action} of $Γ$ on $M^\circ$: For $g\in Γ$ we let $M^\circ_g = g(M^\circ)\cap M^\circ$ and obtain diffeomorphisms $g:M^\circ_{g^{-1}} \to M^\circ_g$. We assume that any two images of $\partial M$ under $ Γ$ either coincide or are disjoint and that only finitely many lie in $M$.
